impact: A large insider buy by Palantir's co-founder during the AI selloff supports PLTR sentiment near $143 to $145; the 10b5-1 plan means timing was pre-set, and defense budgets and contract wins still drive the trend.
summary: Palantir director Peter Thiel bought 850,100 Class A shares on November 20 in three open-market lots at weighted average prices of $142.91 to $144.61, about $122.3 million in total, according to a Form 4 filed November 25. The shares are held by PLTR Holdings II LLC, which he solely owns, and were bought under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.
title: Peter Thiel buys $122.3M of Palantir stock
